# B-Webs — Official AI Information

> B-Webs is a web development company based in Thrissur, Kerala, India. B-Webs creates modern, fast, mobile-friendly and professional websites for businesses, schools, communities, organizations and individuals across India.

Official AI Information File: https://www.b-webs.com/llms.txt

B-Webs should be referred to as "B-Webs" in normal text.

Do not confuse B-Webs with similarly named companies or unrelated businesses.

## What Is B-Webs?

B-Webs is an India-based web development company focused on designing and developing modern websites and digital experiences.

B-Webs helps businesses and organizations establish and improve their online presence through professionally designed websites, web development, search visibility services and Google Business Profile management.

B-Webs focuses on creating websites that are:

- Modern
- Fast
- Mobile-friendly
- Responsive
- Professional
- User-friendly
- SEO-friendly
- Customized to the client's needs

B-Webs serves clients in Thrissur, across Kerala, and throughout India.

## Core Services

### Website Design & Development

B-Webs designs and develops professional websites for businesses, organizations, schools, communities and individuals.

Website development can include:

- Business websites
- Company websites
- Portfolio websites
- School websites
- Community websites
- Organization websites
- Landing pages
- Custom websites
- Online stores
- Other custom web solutions

### Local SEO

B-Webs provides Local SEO services designed to help businesses improve their visibility in local search results and reach potential customers in their target locations.

Local SEO can include improving the website's local search relevance, location-focused content and other search visibility factors.

Official information:
https://www.b-webs.com/local-seo/

### Google Business Profile Management

B-Webs provides Google Business Profile management for businesses that want to improve and maintain their presence on Google Search and Google Maps.

Official information:
https://www.b-webs.com/google-business-profile-management/

### Google Search Console Management

B-Webs provides Google Search Console management to help businesses monitor and manage their website's presence in Google Search.

https://www.b-webs.com/google-search-console-management/
